Messages.Author: Matthew E Strehlow
Messages.Body:
If Javier Montoya is equipped with Catacombs does he burn zero blood
to rescue a vampire, since his ability and the Catacombs each reduce
blood burnt while rescuing by one?

If you control a unique card and bring a second copy into play can
you immediately burn one copy before they go inactive? ie You have
Ignatius in your torpor region and at the end of your influence phase
you bring out a new Ignatius, can you burn the one in torpor, so you
don't have to wait until your untap phase to stop contesting them?

Thanks,
~Matt Strehlow

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Matthew E Strehlow wrote:
>
> If Javier Montoya is equipped with Catacombs does he burn zero blood
> to rescue a vampire, since his ability and the Catacombs each reduce
> blood burnt while rescuing by one?

Yes. Similarly, any vampire with both Humanitas and Catacombs can rescue
a vampire from torpor a for zero blood (and at 3 stealth for vampires
with the same controller).

> If you control a unique card and bring a second copy into play can
> you immediately burn one copy before they go inactive? ie You have
> Ignatius in your torpor region and at the end of your influence phase
> you bring out a new Ignatius, can you burn the one in torpor, so you
> don't have to wait until your untap phase to stop contesting them?

No. You can only yield during your untap phase.

And then, if you yield one, you still have to pay a pool to contest
the other. If you don't, then you must yield both.

And then you still won't get the one that you paid a pool for back
until your next following untap phase.
